method.hotload: Fresh uniquely named ModuleScript clones loaded current MountedTroops, MountKinematics, RigKinematics, OriginalTroops and MountConfig. Only the temporary fixture boundary changed from injected fake-store Play to RunService:IsStudio()/IsEdit(); the checked-in fixture keeps its normal injected-store guard.
method.isolation: All geometry tests use fresh cloned rigs in a temporary ServerStorage folder. No Battle registration, DataStores, profile writes, purchases, player input or user Play changes.
method.red: New focused assertions first failed against the old factory: Wolf/rhino is missing its pair of black eyes.
method.green: All thirteen original-rider appearances, animal ground contacts, native source/shared-client-module pose parity, source immutability and new focused visual/gait assertions passed.
method.poseParity: Shared client RigKinematics executed directly in native Edit, compared against server-produced mounted poses; this is not network or running-client evidence.
method.gallery: An owned temporary NativeMountedGallery displayed fresh factory clones on a marked support slab. Its pose-only gait has no combat authority; seven closeups were captured with Studio MCP and uniformly scaled to 1280px-wide JPEG.

limits: Running-client integration, network behavior, paid combat and physical ragdoll checks are separate parent-owned verification.
Native Edit gallery photos establish fit and facial/shape changes; sampled gait motion and grounding are established by the native FK checks.
